The climate in Rome

Rome is about 58 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 33°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 4°C. Around 870 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 140 mm). The highest temperature in Rome in 2015–2024 was 40°C (18 July 2023) and the lowest −10°C (28 February 2018).

Best time to visit Rome

The most pleasant weather in Rome is usually in April, May, September and October: average highs are between 20°C and 27°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
